blocks.text: 23049 134 Loop Silver Valley Maple Ridge V4R 0E6

parts.t: Custom home situated in Silver Valley! Built in 2021 this home features 6 bedrooms 5 bathrooms, a gourmet kitchen showcases custom millwork and laminated floors that extend throughout the stairs. The spacious entertainers' island and covered deck area provide ample space for hosting gatherings. Formal dining area plus a classic living room with another deck to view on the main floor! Finish it off with a den/office with a full bath. Upstairs is 4 bedrooms and 3 full ensuite baths so every room has a bath! The master bedroom is over the top with a stunning 5 piece ensuite! The basement features a 2-bed suite that is currently rented for $1785 until August/2023. Recently installed heat pump providing A/C & in-floor Heat in the Master bathroom.

v: Reverse 2 Storey w/Bsmt, Three Or More Levels, Two Levels
